fact: The shared backup data centre of the Budget and State Portfolio ministry's directorates-general, in the Yamoussoukro regional tax directorate and outside Abidjan, was inaugurated and operational on 26 July 2021, replicating data from the ministry's data centres.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : Le data Center mutualisé de secours du ministère du Budget et du portefeuille de l'état logé à Yamoussoukro opérationnel depuis lundi
